metadata.description: Software-development-lifecycle tooling for AI engineering work: shared state between a human developer and a coding agent.

plugins.name: plan-layer
plugins.description: A shared planning surface between you and your coding agent. One JSON file is the state; a self-contained HTML page is the view; a gate catches drift; session hooks brief the agent automatically.
plugins.whenToUse: Use on any project where a coding agent and a human both need to know the current state — what is built, what is being worked on, what is deliberately deferred. Most useful when work spans many sessions, because an agent's memory ends with its context window and a human's memory of what the agent did ends sooner.
